chunks: Our father, and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, and Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar (may God be pleased with them) narrated: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hijjal, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Lu'lu'i, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Isma'il ibn Jabir, from al-Karim ibn Amr, from al-Hamid ibn Abi al-Daylam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) advised Ali (peace be upon him) with one thousand gates; each gate opens one thousand gates.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Prophet advising Ali with one thousand gates?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the concept of *Bab al-Hikmah* (Gate of Wisdom), portraying Imam Ali as the comprehensive repository of the Prophet’s esoteric and exoteric teachings. The metaphor of 'one thousand gates, each opening another thousand' underscores the infinite depth of divine knowledge (*Ilm*) transmitted through the Ahl al-Bayt, a key tenet in Shia hermeneutics for understanding the Quran's layers of meaning.
